summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of iteration_4 features (Admin Permits CRUD tab + Urgent Jobs live alerts). 10/10 scripted flows passed. Admin permits show the 6 seeded Ontario requirements; create/edit/delete work with proper toasts; public /permits shows user-added permits; driver RBAC blocks /admin and redirects to /dashboard. Urgent jobs polling (15s) fires sonner toast AND renders red Card [data-testid='urgent-jobs-alert'] within ~10s after admin POSTs an emergency job; Dismiss and View All buttons function correctly. All QA-created permits and jobs were cleaned up via API.

issues: React warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' on both New Permit and Edit Permit dialogs. Cosmetic a11y warning only — consider adding <DialogDescription> to silence.

action_items: (Optional/low) Silence Radix Dialog a11y warning by adding a <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to the Add Permit and Edit Permit DialogContents in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.js.

(Informational, not blocking) Permits table in Admin does not render the 'description' column — edit-description changes are not visually confirmable from the table row (verified via toast only). Consider surfacing description in a tooltip or extra column.
critical_code_review_comments: useUrgentJobAlerts first-poll seed works as documented: the initial /api/jobs fetch seeds the seen-set without firing a toast, so the test correctly waited ~6s before creating the job. This behavior should be preserved.
DashboardPage.js correctly uses data-testid='urgent-jobs-alert', 'dismiss-urgent-btn', 'view-urgent-btn' per spec. No blocking issues.

AdminDashboardPage.js: Add/Edit permit dialogs use Textarea for description with no data-testid — added selectors by fallback worked, but giving the description textarea a stable testid would harden tests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin permits tab, urgent-jobs polling, sonner toast integration, and driver RBAC are fully verified. Two browser contexts were used for the live-alert test: driver kept dashboard open, admin POSTed jobs via page.request (REST). Poll cadence observed at ~10s to show in UI after POST (interval is 15s but first probe hits within window). JobCreate schema requires: title, pickup_address, delivery_address, pickup_city, delivery_city, goods_type, estimated_distance_km, offered_price, urgency — reference /app/backend/server.py L153-164. Admin login returns 'access_token' (not 'token').
